status.volume_role: main rescuer and emotional key to restoring Stella
status.condition: survives lethal wounds, Ittou Rasetsu strain, forced growth under Excessive Awakening, and later recovers enough for training and wedding preparations

personality.summary: Ikki begins the volume frantic and almost self-destructive after Stella's abduction, but repeatedly regains himself through trust in Shizuku, Ouma, Edelweiss and Stella. His defining strength is not raw power but refusing defeat and answering others' hopes without abandoning tomorrow.
values: saving Stella without sacrificing her loved ones
responding to others' trust and admiration
flaws: initially tries to shoulder everything alone
nearly mistakes killing possessed Stella for the only way to protect her legacy
still struggles to acknowledge his own worth

abilities_owned: temporary Shizuku-assisted water and ice techniques
expanded causal cutting after Excessive Awakening

relationships.stella-vermillion: Beloved fiancee and strongest rival; he saves her by challenging the buried admiration that began their bond rather than by pleading as a lover.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Younger sister and essential partner; trusts her healing, judgment and final fusion magic despite her own self-doubt.
relationships.ouma-kurogane: Elder brother; Ouma helps clear the route, rebukes Ikki's despair, and protects the team from Stella's possessed blast.
relationships.itsuki-kurogane: Father; finally authorizes the rescue as both Japan branch head and father, accepting responsibility for Ikki's operation.
relationships.edelweiss: Mentor/rival figure; stops Ikki's self-destructive attempt and reminds him his strength is advancing toward tomorrow.
relationships.karl-eilands: Enemy who imitates an idealized future Ikki but fails because he cannot understand trust or rivalry.

periods.summary: After awakening from near-fatal injuries, Ikki learns Karl Eilands abducted Stella and joins Shizuku, Ouma, Touka and Alice in a sanctioned rescue. In Eilands' underground lab he fights alongside Shizuku, defeats Darwin's monstrous body by accepting severe wounds and using a water-double trap, then battles Eilands' Perfect Fortune imitation of his future swordsmanship. He and Shizuku defeat that body, but Eilands has already infiltrated Stella and uses her to stab Ikki. When Eilands tries to kill Shizuku with Stella's body, Ikki nearly sacrifices all future through Excessive Awakening before Edelweiss, Ouma and Shizuku restore his resolve. Shizuku fuses him into Stella's body; in Stella's mind, Ikki realizes their bond began in mutual admiration and attacks her with Tsuikage, trusting she will answer as his greatest rival. Stella awakens and expels Eilands. By October Ikki recovers, receives recommendations for KOK A-class, reflects on his journey from Worst One to acknowledged knight, and travels to Vermillion for his wedding with Stella.

key_events.summary: Receives his father's order and responsibility guarantee to rescue Stella.
Invades Eilands' Nikko underground laboratory with Shizuku, Ouma, Touka and Alice.
Uses Shizuku's support and a water-double trap to cut down Darwin's giant body.
Fights Stella's buried self in her mind and restores her by calling forth their mutual admiration.
Recovers, learns of A-class KOK eligibility, and heads to Vermillion for his wedding.
